summary: Traverses a sibling-linked scene node list rooted at `this`. For each node, reads a visibility/state mask at this+0x38 and breaks out of the traversal when the node mask is non-zero yet the masked global render visibility mask (0x008B8E34 combined with the caller mask at a2+0x84) does not fully cover it. Otherwise dispatches animation updates via AnimationDispatchWithSkipFlag(a2), recurses into children when this+0x44 is set, then follows the next-sibling pointer at this+0x4C until it is null or the sibling continuation flag at this+0x40 is zero.

operations.description: Read node mask this+0x38; if it is non-zero AND (global mask 0x008B8E34 & node mask & caller mask a2+0x84) != node mask, break out of the traversal, skipping this node and its subtree.
Dispatch animation updates for the node with AnimationDispatchWithSkipFlag(a2).
If the children flag this+0x44 is non-zero, recurse into child nodes via RecursiveStateTraversalWithFlagCheck(a2).
If the sibling continuation flag this+0x40 is zero, break out of the traversal.
Advance the traversal pointer to the next sibling node at this+0x4C.
do-while loop over the sibling chain: continues while the current node pointer is non-null.
Return the last read node mask / sibling flag value that caused loop termination.

unresolved: Meaning of the caller-supplied mask at a2+0x84 and how it combines with the node and global masks.
Recursive call passes a2 rather than a child pointer; the callee's own 'this' argument must be derived elsewhere (possibly from a2's context).
Ownership and exact node object type are unknown.
